title: Senior Associate Supply Chain Compliance Management (Amgen External Planning)
description:
India \- Hyderabad
JOB ID: R\-243158 LOCATION: India \- Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: May. 07, 2026 CATEGORY: Supply Chain
**HOW MIGHT YOU DEFY IMAGINATION?**


If you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. At Amgen, our shared mission—to serve patients—drives all that we do. It is key to our becoming one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies. We are global collaborators who achieve together—researching, manufacturing, and delivering ever\-better products that reach over 10 million patients worldwide. It’s time for a career you can be proud of.

**Senior Associate, Compliance Management (Amgen External Planning)**

**What you will do**


Let’s do this! Let’s change the world! In this vital role you will be part of the External Planning and Delivery Team, which is responsible for strategy and execution of all aspects of supply chain supporting our external manufacturing network.


The Senior Associate Amgen External Planning (AXP) reports to the Business Performance Manager of Supply Planning at the Amgen India, Hyderabad site. In this role, the Senior Associate Supply Chain Compliance is responsible for leading and maintaining compliance infrastructure for the External Planning organization ensuring that all GMP and non\-GMP documentation, training, and procedural requirements are established, maintained, and continuously improved to support operational excellence. This individual will serve as the compliance lead for the External Supply team, owning Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Deviation and Change Controls, training governance, inspection readiness support, and adherence to internal Amgen policies and global regulatory requirements. This role will require a close partnership with Amgen External Supply, Global / Regional / Site Supply Chain, Global Distribution, and External Quality.


AXP is a critical component of Amgen’s Global Supply Chain, responsible for enabling reliable, efficient, and agile planning and delivery operations for Amgen’s CMO\-sourced products. The Senior Associate, based at Amgen’s Hyderabad site, will be a key member of this team and a foundational contributor to the External Planning work center, supporting the business performance and continuous improvement of planning operations. The role requires strong knowledge of GMP environments, document management systems, and cross\-functional collaboration within a highly regulated biopharmaceutical supply chain.

**Responsibilities:**

*Compliance \& SOP Governance*

* Own and manage all team SOPs (GMP and non\-GMP), work instructions, and guiding documents.
* Lead periodic SOP reviews, revisions, and lifecycle management in alignment with Amgen quality systems.
* Ensure alignment of team procedures with global policies, regulatory requirements, and CMO oversight standards.
* Coordinate cross\-functional reviews and approvals of procedural documents.
* Maintain document control and ensure inspection readiness at all times.
* Monitor and report performance metrics (e.g., cycle time, aging, on\-time closure); escalate overdue items.
* Monitor and report (SOP, training, regulatory commitments, deviations and change management) trending and provide leadership with insights and action plans for improvement.

*Training Management*

* Own and track all team training requirements (GMP and non\-GMP).
* Manage training completion, driving closure of overdue items.
* Partner with Quality and HR to ensure accurate training curricula and assignment.
* Develop training materials and support onboarding of new team members.
* Prepare compliance dashboards and periodic status reports.

*Regulatory \& Audit Support*

* Support internal and external audits and inspections related to External Supply operations and documentation practices.
* Track and manage compliance commitments, CAPAs, and action items for the team.
* Ensure proper documentation and archival of audit\-related records.
* Partner with Quality Assurance to ensure inspection readiness across the External Planning function.

*Deviation \& Change Control Management*

* Own and manage deviations and change control records across AXP supply chain operations.
* Ensure timely initiation, routing, and closure in accordance with procedures and timelines.
* Maintain accurate, complete, and compliant records within quality systems.
* Support workflow execution through coordination, tracking, and documentation updates.
* Ensure audit readiness with complete, accurate, and inspection\-ready records.

*Continuous Improvement*

* Monitor adherence to established procedures and identify compliance gaps.
* Drive process improvements to simplify documentation, training tracking, and governance workflows.
* Support risk assessments and change management activities impacting External Planning.

*Key Skills \& Competencies*

* Strong attention to detail and compliance mindset
* High level of ownership and accountability
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Proactive problem\-solving skills
* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills

**What we expect of you**


We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a leader with these qualifications.

**Basic Qualifications:**
-------------------------

* Any degree and 5\-9 years’ supply chain experience in GMP\-regulated pharmaceutical / biotechnology industry, or related business fields


In addition to meeting above requirements, you must have at least 2 years’ experience working in teams, projects, and programs. This experience may run concurrently with the required GMP\-regulated experience referenced above.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* Experience in Supply Chain, External Manufacturing, or Quality within a GMP environment.
* Strong knowledge of GMP documentation practices and quality systems.
* Experience managing SOPs and document control systems.
* Familiarity with document management systems and training compliance tracking.
* Experience supporting audits or regulatory inspections.
* Strong organizational and project management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to operate independently while partnering cross\-functionally.
* Proficiency in MS Office and document management systems.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist II
description:
Talent Acquisition Specialist II
Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
  

  

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.
  

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  

  

Why Syneos Health
  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.
**Job Responsibilities**

**Job responsibilities**  

* In conjunction with all of Talent Acquisition, creates a deep and diverse talent pool to service resourcing requirements across multiple business units.
* Collaborates directly with hiring managers to understand business and skill set requirements to build a comprehensive strategic hiring plan by setting the vision, strategy, and goals to ensure current and future resource demands are met.
* As a strategic partner to your hiring managers, provide expertise in market insights, talent landscape, and an understanding of talent needs to establish expectations and build a collaborative approach with your customers to meet demands.
* Ensure customer satisfaction by providing regular updates to hiring managers and setting expectations on the hiring process per requisition or department, or both, as required.
* Utilize appropriate sourcing channels (including applicant tracking system, candidate relationship management system, job boards, advertising, networking, employee referral program) to identify qualified candidates.
* Monitor recruitment sourcing methods and provide recommendations to improve applicant attraction. Suggests innovative solutions to sourcing challenges and competitive intelligence from those efforts.
* Offers creative solutions to sourcing hard to fill requisitions in collaboration with the business.
* Responsible to manage full cycle recruiting process to include but not limited to: complete initial screening interview of potential candidates and reject non\-relevant applications, prepare candidate profile for hiring manager following interview screen, submit short listed candidates to hiring managers for review, conducts candidate debrief session after interviews are completed and extends verbal offers of employment to successful candidates.
* Ensures data accuracy within Applicant Tracking System.
* Initiates and maintains open communication with hiring managers and Human Resources (HR) colleagues in meeting recruiting needs.
* May create collateral HR materials for trade shows, professional organization meetings, and career fairs. May attend trade shows, professional organization meetings and career fairs.
* May provide training and coaching activities for Talent Acquisition Specialists.
* Performs other job\-related duties as assigned
**Qualifications \- External**

**What we’re looking for**  

Basic Qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience
* Experience as a Talent Acquisition Specialist / Recruiter in a corporate or agency environment
* Proven track record in direct sourcing and managing an end\-to\-end recruiting process required
* Demonstrated leadership skills
* Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to think and influence strategically
* Proven track record in utilizing creative recruitment techniques and measurement of results
* Ability to work well with multi\-functional team and with all levels within organization
* Strong problem solving, influencing, negotiating, facilitating and partnership skills required
* Ability to effectively engage and build relationships with line management, employees, and HR team at all levels
* Excellent organizational skills and ability to effectively manage multiple demands without missing deadlines
* Strong time management skills and able to work independently
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
* Strong written and oral communication skills
* Strong customer services skills
* Strong attention to detail and an ability to maintain confidentiality
Preferred Qualifications
  

* Experience as a full cycle Talent Acquisition Specialist / Recruiter supporting a CRO or in the Pharmaceutical industry
* Experience working in Workday
* Experience with a CRM
**Get to know Syneos Health**

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.


No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.  

  



http://www.syneoshealth.com

title: Recruitment Coordinator (On Contract)
description:
Role Description:

As a Recruitment Coordinator at Booking Holdings India (Center of Excellence), you’ll be a key enabler of a seamless, high\-impact recruiting experience. You’ll partner closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and external stakeholders to manage interview coordination, candidate communication, and recruitment logistics across multiple time zones.

  

This role calls for strong operational rigor, attention to detail, and a passion for delivering outstanding candidate and stakeholder experiences. You’ll play a critical role in supporting our Talent Acquisition efforts, while also contributing to process enhancements, employer brand initiatives, and recruitment events.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Manage end\-to\-end interview coordination including scheduling, logistics, communication with candidates, and interviewer support across time zones.
* Act as the primary point of contact for candidates and interviewers throughout the interview process, ensuring clarity and a high\-touch experience.
* Ensure all candidate and interview\-related information is tracked accurately across systems (e.g., iCIMS, Workday, Google Suite).
* Manage logistics for in\-person and virtual interviews, including executive\-level sessions and technical setups (Zoom, Skype, Lifesize, etc.).
* Partner with recruiters on job postings, initial screening, and process documentation when needed.
* Support employer branding initiatives and recruitment events (e.g., job fairs, meetups, diversity events) in coordination with the Events team.
* Actively contributes to enhancing talent acquisition and onboarding processes, driving team efficiency and ensuring a consistently exceptional candidate experience.
* Manages end\-to\-end candidate travel logistics for both domestic and international interviews, including visa documentation and reimbursement of expenses.
* Seamlessly manages multiple candidate schedules on a daily basis, including high\-volume Sprint Days, ensuring all interviews are well\-coordinated and executed with precision.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve scheduling workflows, reduce bottlenecks, and streamline the candidate experience.
* Lead the complete offer management process \& work in partnership with the recruitment team \& HR Ops team.
* Work in conjunction with offered candidates to understand their perspective and take them along in pre\-onboarding journey

**Requirements/Experience**

* 5\+ years of proven experience in recruitment coordination or talent operations within dynamic, high\-volume, and fast\-paced environments.
* Strong organizational, prioritization, and multitasking skills with a high level of attention to detail.
* Proactive and solution\-focused, with a strong sense of ownership and the initiative to drive operational excellence.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to craft professional messages and build rapport with candidates and internal stakeholders.
* Tech\-savvy with experience using applicant tracking systems (e.g., iCIMS) and collaboration tools (Google Suite, Zoom).
* Resilient and adaptable; thrives in high\-pressure situations and remains agile in the face of shifting priorities.
* Team player with a collaborative mindset, yet confident working independently.
* Strong understanding of the talent acquisition lifecycle and passion for delivering exceptional candidate experiences.
* Ability to manage sensitive information with discretion and maintain confidentiality.
* Possesses strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and apply insights to drive creative, effective solutions.
* Willingness to support occasional after\-hours events as needed.
* Deep passion for talent acquisition and thrives in a collaborative, close\-knit team environment.
* Self\-assured, proactive, and energized by fast\-paced, constantly evolving settings.
* Brings a positive, engaging presence to the workplace, with a great sense of fun and a contagious enthusiasm that uplifts the team.

**What You Bring \- Personality \& Professional Presence**

* Driven, energetic, and highly motivated, hands\-on in execution while thinking strategically about talent.
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to craft compelling conversations that capture and engage the interest of top talent.
* Highly articulate; adept at conveying complex ideas and engaging senior stakeholders with clarity, professionalism, and influence.
* Balances tenacity with emotional intelligence, knows when to persist and when to pivot.
* Self\-assured, composed under pressure, and quick on their feet in dynamic situations.
* Naturally outgoing and personable; enjoys connecting with people from diverse backgrounds and functions.
* Curious by nature, with a genuine desire to learn, grow, and stay ahead of trends.
* Demonstrates executive presence and is confident in navigating interactions with senior leaders.
* Strong commercial awareness with a solid understanding of business models, performance metrics, and industry dynamics, able to draw insights and communicate them effectively with both internal and external stakeholders.

Contract Workmen Management • Oversee engagement, deployment, and monitoring of contract workmen across departments. • Ensure manpower availability as per production and maintenance requirements. • Maintain accurate records of contractor workforce, attendance, and wage verification. • Ensure adherence to GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) standards by contract staff. • Address grievances of contract workmen. 2\. Statutory Compliance • Ensure compliance with applicable labor laws such as: o Contract Labour (Regulation \& Abolition) Act o Minimum Wages Act o EPF, ESIC regulations o Bonus, Gratuity, and Shops \& Establishment Act (if applicable) • Conduct regular audits of contractor documentation and statutory registers. • Liaise with government authorities, inspectors, and auditors. • Ensure timely submission of statutory returns and documentation. 3\. Vendor / Contractor Management • Identify, onboard, and evaluate labor contractors. • Monitor contractor performance, billing, and SLA adherence. • Verify contractor invoices against attendance and statutory compliance. • Ensure contractors adhere to safety, hygiene, and compliance standards. 4\. description:
About the Opportunity
  
The Services Consultant is responsible for all phases of a new client coming onto Dayforce’s system or an existing client upgrading to a new Dayforce processing product. They work in a project team to provide clients with effective solutions that are aligned to our commitment of reliable, repeatable and quality implementation practices.
  
  

What you'll get to do
  
* Ability to translate business process requirements into configuration requirements for the Dayforce Solution purchased with differing levels of complexity.
* Will work in conjunction with Project Manager and Project Team in the completion of an implementation.

* Responsible for contributing to project plans and ensuring project is on time, meets and/or exceeds client expectations and follows internal processes.

* Ability to consult customer on business needs
* Ability to engage with multiple projects \& customers at the same time and manage priorities accordingly
* Excellent organization, communication, and collaboration skills
* Ability to lead and facilitate customer workshops and sessions
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Prior functional experience with Dayforce HCM would be an asset
* Prior consultative experience with employee data integration or HCM software
* Proficient in Microsoft Office products
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, IT, or any IT related field

* Excellent documentation skills
* Superior customer support experience
* Experience working with North American clients and vendors a benefit

title: Variable Compensation Associate
description:
**About this role:**

The Variable Compensation Associate plays a crucial role within our VC Care team, supporting the administration of worldwide Sales, Consulting, Conference, and Specialist Compensation Plans. You will assist commission\-eligible associates with compensation\-related inquiries, disputes, and escalations, provide education and training on compensation details, and perform recurring monthly processes as well as ad\-hoc reporting and analysis regarding bookings data, revenue performance, commission earnings, and annual sales awards attainment. This position requires strong analytical skills, exceptional customer service, and proficiency in Excel.


**What you'll do:**

* Complete recurring manual tasks for processes not systematically automated, frequent use of Excel, SQL, and SaaS commission applications
* Maintain commission application by performing data inputs, validation, and data quality checks on both imports and exports
* Assist commission\-eligible associates with inquiries related to commission, compensation, quota, earnings, and related topics via multiple channels (email, chat, etc.)
* Engage with Sales Associates to explain and support their understanding of commission calculations, adjustments, and payments
* Conduct thorough research and analysis to resolve inquiries, investigating anomalies to determine root causes and propose solutions
* Review monthly commission payments, confirm calculations by reconciling data to source systems, and sign\-off on payment integrity
* Process adjustment requests according to established documentation
* Generate ad\-hoc sales reports and analyses for leadership and business partners as needed
* Deliver formal and ad\-hoc training sessions to commission\-eligible associates
* Collaborate and coordinate among financial, sales, and operational departments
* Participate in testing system enhancements as required
* Drive continuous improvement by supporting initiatives, taking ownership of responsibilities, and meeting department SLAs, goals, and objectives
* Coordinate and complete additional projects as requested

**What you'll need:**

* 1 year of relevant experience, professional development, relevant college coursework, or specialized certifications
* Proficiency in basic Excel functions including VLOOKUP, pivot tables, data filtering and sorting, and strong data analytical skills
* Understanding of SQL, basic query writing, and use of pre\-written templates is a plus
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, effective listening skills, and the ability to support a high volume of inquiries in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong problem\-solving skills, curious mindset, and ability to resolve complex inquiries with available resources
* Comfortable working with large data sets from multiple sources
* Ability to understand compensation plan elements
* Flexibility and adaptability to manage ambiguity, unexpected changes, and foster continuous improvement
* Willingness to take initiative and accept new projects proactively
* Excellent organization and time management skills
* Motivated, high\-potential performer, with a self\-starter attitude

* Able to solve complex problems and successfully manage ambiguity and unexpected change

In addition to an outstanding work environment with rapid advancement potential, Gartner associates enjoy exceptional compensation and benefits, including:

* Limitless growth. We work with you to help you meet your goals and advance within the company

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.


Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.


We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.


**Gartner is the world authority on AI**

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.


It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.


**What do we offer?**

Gartner offers world\-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.


In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

* Naturally curious and highly analytical, with the ability to synthesize large amounts of information into clear insights to drive practical recommendations

Join our dynamic Talent Acquisition team as a Recruiting Professional, where you'll utilize your expertise in the banking or financial services industry to attract and engage top\-tier candidates.




**Job Summary**


As a Executive Director in Global Technology, you will play a critical role in attracting, sourcing and recruiting top talent, managing the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle for Technology, Product and Data roles and providing strategic talent acquisition solutions.


You will focus on experienced hire roles across the Technology, Product and Data, with positions ranging from Analyst to Executive Director. In addition to working on open roles, you will engage in ongoing candidate development and presentation, as well as opportunistic candidate engagement. Your role will also encompass supporting all aspects of Talent Acquisition \& Talent Management for Global Technology, including competitive intelligence, market mapping, succession planning, and confidential project work. The ability to foster strong client relationships with senior managers and candidates is essential, and your consultative, strategic thought leadership will be key to your success.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Lead end\-to\-end, full life cycle recruitment, from direct approach to completion.
* Conduct requirement intake calls with hiring managers, offering guidance on recruitment processes, controls, and policies.
* Evaluate, interview, and present qualified candidates to hiring managers, refining recruiting strategies based on feedback.
* Serve as a subject matter expert, influencing decision\-making and effectively managing hiring manager and candidate expectations.
* Educate candidates on career growth potential, benefits, compensation philosophy, and the advantages of employment, ensuring successful offer closures.
* Develop and implement diversity strategies, educating hiring managers to present a diverse candidate slate.
* Provide meaningful market data to support client needs.
* Manage a team of 3 to 4 members.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills**

* Relevant experience with full life cycle recruiting in a fast\-paced corporate environment or search firm.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage complex assignments and multiple searches while delivering exceptional client service.
* Excellent relationship management skills with both clients and candidates.
* High comfort level with direct sourcing and the ability to engage currently employed candidates.
* Knowledge of executive compensation packages across different competitors and industries, with the ability to negotiate complex compensation deals.




**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills**

* Prior experience working in a search firm, combined with corporate experience.

Morgan and Chase brands. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we’re setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

**Description**


Talent Acquisition Specialist II
Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.  

  

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.  

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  

  

Why Syneos Health  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.
**Job Responsibilities**

**Job responsibilities**  

* In conjunction with all of Talent Acquisition, creates a deep and diverse talent pool to service resourcing requirements across multiple business units.
* Collaborates directly with hiring managers to understand business and skill set requirements to build a comprehensive strategic hiring plan by setting the vision, strategy, and goals to ensure current and future resource demands are met.
* As a strategic partner to your hiring managers, provide expertise in market insights, talent landscape, and an understanding of talent needs to establish expectations and build a collaborative approach with your customers to meet demands.
* Ensure customer satisfaction by providing regular updates to hiring managers and setting expectations on the hiring process per requisition or department, or both, as required.
* Utilize appropriate sourcing channels (including applicant tracking system, candidate relationship management system, job boards, advertising, networking, employee referral program) to identify qualified candidates.
* Monitor recruitment sourcing methods and provide recommendations to improve applicant attraction. Suggests innovative solutions to sourcing challenges and competitive intelligence from those efforts.
* Offers creative solutions to sourcing hard to fill requisitions in collaboration with the business.
* Responsible to manage full cycle recruiting process to include but not limited to: complete initial screening interview of potential candidates and reject non\-relevant applications, prepare candidate profile for hiring manager following interview screen, submit short listed candidates to hiring managers for review, conducts candidate debrief session after interviews are completed and extends verbal offers of employment to successful candidates.
* Ensures data accuracy within Applicant Tracking System.
* Initiates and maintains open communication with hiring managers and Human Resources (HR) colleagues in meeting recruiting needs.
* May create collateral HR materials for trade shows, professional organization meetings, and career fairs. May attend trade shows, professional organization meetings and career fairs.
* May provide training and coaching activities for Talent Acquisition Specialists.
* Performs other job\-related duties as assigned
**Qualifications \- External**

**What we’re looking for**  

Basic Qualifications  

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience
* Experience as a Talent Acquisition Specialist / Recruiter in a corporate or agency environment
* Proven track record in direct sourcing and managing an end\-to\-end recruiting process required
* Demonstrated leadership skills
* Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to think and influence strategically
* Proven track record in utilizing creative recruitment techniques and measurement of results
* Ability to work well with multi\-functional team and with all levels within organization
* Strong problem solving, influencing, negotiating, facilitating and partnership skills required
* Ability to effectively engage and build relationships with line management, employees, and HR team at all levels
* Excellent organizational skills and ability to effectively manage multiple demands without missing deadlines
* Strong time management skills and able to work independently
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
* Strong written and oral communication skills
* Strong customer services skills
* Strong attention to detail and an ability to maintain confidentiality

Preferred Qualifications  

* Experience as a full cycle Talent Acquisition Specialist / Recruiter supporting a CRO or in the Pharmaceutical industry
* Experience working in Workday
* Experience with a CRM
**Get to know Syneos Health**


Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.


No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

  

http://www.syneoshealth.com

Job Description:**About McDonald’s:**


One of the world’s largest employers with locations in more than 100 countries, McDonald’s Corporation has corporate opportunities in Hyderabad. Our global offices serve as dynamic innovation and operations hubs, designed to expand McDonald's global talent base and in\-house expertise. Our new office in Hyderabad will bring together knowledge across business, technology, analytics, and AI, accelerating our ability to deliver impactful solutions for the business and our customers across the globe.

**Department Overview**
-----------------------


McDonald’s currently has an exciting opportunity for a talented and experienced Manager, Talent Attraction, Delivery to. The Manager, Talent Attraction Delivery (McHire) will lead the design, execution, and continuous improvement of global recruiting platform for restaurant. This role ensures that recruiting activities are efficient, consistent, and aligned with enterprise\-wide talent strategies, while delivering a seamless experience for candidates and hiring managers.

**Duties**
----------

**Recruiting Operations Leadership**

* Collect, evaluate, and prioritize market\-specific recruiting needs to inform global roadmap planning and delivery
* Define and maintain the overall ATS platform roadmap, ensuring alignment across markets and functions.
* Oversee day\-to\-day restaurant recruiting operations processes for the platform across markets.
* Monitor, measure, and improve process efficiency, service delivery, and compliance with policies and regulations globally.
* Evaluate operational metrics / reporting to track performance and inform decision\-making.

**Process \& Technology Enablement**

* Partner with Functional Solutions teams to optimize the applicant tracking system and related platforms for scalability and efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate recruiting processes across markets.

* Collaborate closely with the business, markets, Functional Solutions, support teams, global and local technology teams to address escalations, exceptions, and service delivery issues through process improvements / changes.
* Support change management and training efforts to embed new processes and tools across the organization.
**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field

* Excellent communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to operate in a fast\-paced, matrixed, and global environment.

title: HR Executive
description:
Role Overview

This is an executional HR role with end\-to\-end responsibility for the moving parts of recruitment, onboarding, employee records, and office operations. You will work directly with the CEO, with senior oversight on strategic and policy decisions.

You will own the process, not just support it. The right person for this role is detail\-oriented, follows up without being asked, and treats discretion as non\-negotiable.

Key Responsibilities

**Recruitment Coordination (50%)**

* Post jobs on Naukri, LinkedIn, Cutshort, Indeed, and other platforms against approved JDs
* Screen incoming CVs against role\-specific checklists provided by hiring managers
* Schedule interviews and coordinate between candidates and the hiring panel
* Maintain candidate pipelines and trackers in our CRM (Bitrix24 — training provided)
* Coordinate offer letter rollout, joining documentation, and pre\-joining engagement
* Conduct reference checks for shortlisted candidates

**HR Operations (30%)**

* Maintain attendance, leave records, and employee data
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs with the finance team
* Manage onboarding paperwork: offer letters, joining kits, ID and tool access setup
* Manage exit formalities: relieving letters, full and final settlements, experience certificates
* Maintain employee records, contracts, and HR documentation

Corvi Technologies is a growing technology services company working closely with startups, product companies, and fast\-scaling technology organizations. We specialize in delivering high‑quality technical talent across modern engineering and digital stacks.

**Routine Responsibilities**

* **Expense Auditing:** Review, validate against Forescout's Travel, Entertainment \& Expense Policy and internal guidelines, and process employee out\-of\-pocket expense reimbursements and corporate credit card transactions. This includes:

* Confirming business purpose and appropriate manager approvals
* Flagging non\-reimbursable or policy\-non\-compliant items
* Ensuring expense reports are actioned within the stipulated SLA
* Identifying anomalies — duplicate submissions, missing receipts, personal charges on corporate cards, weekend or unusual\-pattern expenses — and escalating to the AP Manager or Controller

* **Exception Tracking:** Maintain exception trackers for invoice discrepancies and ensure all exceptions are actioned within SLA timelines.
* **Vendor Query Resolution:** Respond to vendor and employee queries received via email and ticketing systems within agreed SLA; escalate unresolved issues to senior team members.
* **Payment Support:** Assist in preparation of weekly payment batches for vendor bills and employee expense reports across international entities.
* **Compliance:** Perform all transactional tasks in compliance with Forescout's internal control procedures and AP guidelines.
* **Documentation:** Maintain process exception logs for knowledge retention and audit readiness.
* **Reconciliation Support:** Assist senior accountants with vendor statement reconciliations and month\-end close activities.
* **Follow\-up:** Follow up with internal requisitioners (via calls, emails, or tickets) to seek hold approvals on invoices as per AP guidelines.

**Non\-Routine Responsibilities**

* Participate in process improvement initiatives to enhance AP workflow efficiency.
* Support implementation of updated AP policies and procedures.
* Assist with internal and external audit queries related to AP transactions.
* Learn and operate ERP systems (Oracle) for invoice and payment processing.

* **Minimum:** Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com), Accounting, or Finance

* **0–3 years:** of experience in Accounts Payable, Finance \& Accounting, or a related field

* Familiarity with ERP systems such as Oracle, SAP, COUPA or NetSuite (any one)

* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain high accuracy in high\-volume environments
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English for vendor and stakeholder correspondence
* Ability to work independently on assigned tasks and escalate issues proactively
* Team player with a willingness to learn and take on new responsibilities

**Behavioral Attributes**

* Self\-motivated, hardworking, and able to work under pressure during month\-end close periods
* Integrity and accountability in handling sensitive financial data
* Flexible and adaptable to shift timings (role may require 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST shift to align with global operations)

**What Forescout Offers You**
Our visionary leadership team fosters an environment that encourages professional growth and development. We champion a diverse and inclusive culture that cultivates collaboration and innovation, where our team can make a global impact on security while working with industry\-leading technology. We take pride in offering a competitive total compensation package. If you have a strong work ethic, are visible and lean in, you will be recognised. We are in growth mode and there is a ton of opportunity at Forescout. Apply now to find out more!**More About Forescout**
Forescout Technologies, Inc., a global cybersecurity leader, continuously identifies, protects and helps ensure the compliance of all managed and unmanaged cyber assets – IT, IoT, IoMT and OT. For more than 20 years, Fortune 100 organisations and government agencies have trusted Forescout to provide vendor\-agnostic, automated cybersecurity at scale.

With seamless context sharing and workflow orchestration via ecosystem partners, it enables customers to more effectively manage cyber risk and mitigate threats. Learn more at **www.Forescout.com**.**Our Mission**
To continuously identify, protect, and ensure the compliance of all cyber assets across the modern organisation.**Our Vision**
A world where every cyber asset is seen, secure and compliant.**Our Cultural Values*** Cyber Obsessed – We are curious about technology, and we are innovative and passionate about solving big programs.
* Customer Driven – We listen, we learn, and we make it right.

* Relentless – We're smart, determined, and find a way. We figure stuff out.

At Forescout, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We believe that diversity of background, experiences, and perspectives leads to innovation, creativity, and better decision making. We strive to create an environment where all team members feel valued, respected, and empowered. title: Junior Executive - HR
description:
**Position Overview**

The Junior Executive – Human Resources is an entry\-to\-mid level position based at the Head Office. The incumbent will work closely with the HR Manager and the broader HR team to support the full spectrum of HR operations, including recruitment, onboarding, employee records management, payroll coordination, performance management, and compliance. This role provides excellent exposure to both the strategic and transactional dimensions of HR in a dynamic trading environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Talent Acquisition \& Recruitment**

* Coordinate end\-to\-end recruitment activities including drafting job postings, screening resumes, scheduling interviews, and maintaining candidate pipelines for head office and store\-level roles.
* Liaise with department heads to understand manpower requirements and prepare requisition documentation.
* Manage relationships with recruitment agencies, job portals, and campus placement partners.
* Conduct initial telephonic/in\-person screening interviews for junior and mid\-level vacancies.
* Prepare offer letters, appointment letters, and coordinate pre\-joining formalities.

**2\. Onboarding \& Induction**

* Facilitate structured onboarding programmes for new joiners, ensuring a smooth transition into the organisation.
* Coordinate induction schedules, prepare orientation materials, and liaise with IT, Admin, and Finance for new hire setup.
* Track probation periods and ensure timely confirmation reviews are conducted.

**3\. Employee Records \& HRIS Management**

* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee records in the Human Resource Information System (HRIS) including personal data, employment history, leave balances, and documentation.
* Ensure timely filing and safekeeping of all physical and digital employee files in compliance with data protection policies.
* Generate periodic HR reports on headcount, attrition, absenteeism, and other key metrics for management review.

**4\. Payroll \& Attendance Coordination**

* Assist in monthly payroll processing by collating attendance data, leave records, overtime, and variable pay inputs from departments.
* Coordinate with Finance for payroll disbursement and resolve salary\-related queries from employees.
* Maintain accurate leave management records and administer the leave management system.

**5\. Performance Management**

* Support the annual and mid\-year performance appraisal cycle by circulating forms, tracking submissions, and maintaining appraisal records.
* Assist in preparing performance improvement plans (PIPs) documentation and follow\-up scheduling.
* Coordinate 360\-degree feedback collection and analysis as directed by the HR Manager.

**6\. Employee Relations \& Engagement**

* Serve as a first point of contact for employee queries related to HR policies, benefits, and procedures.
* Assist in planning and executing employee engagement initiatives, welfare programmes, team\-building events, and recognition activities.
* Support grievance handling processes by documenting complaints, scheduling hearings, and maintaining confidentiality.
* Assist in conducting exit interviews and compiling attrition analysis reports.

**7\. Training \& Development**

* Coordinate training needs identification (TNI) exercises in liaison with department heads.
* Organise internal and external training programmes including scheduling, logistics, vendor coordination, and post\-training feedback collection.
* Maintain a training calendar and track training hours, certifications, and skill development records.

**8\. Statutory Compliance \& HR Administration**

* Assist in ensuring compliance with applicable labour laws including the Shops \& Establishments Act, PF, ESI, gratuity, and other statutory requirements relevant to the footwear trading sector.
* Support audits and inspections by preparing required documentation and reports.
* Draft HR communications including notices, circulars, memos, and policy updates.
* Coordinate with legal counsel for documentation related to employment contracts and disciplinary matters.

**9\. General HR Administration**

* Maintain the HR department's filing systems, correspondence logs, and internal communication records.
* Support the HR team in special projects, policy reviews, and process improvement initiatives as assigned.
* Coordinate inter\-departmental HR activities between head office and branch/store locations.

**Qualifications \& Educational Requirements**

**Minimum Qualification**

Bachelor's Degree (B.Com, BBA, B.A. or equivalent)

**Preferred Qualification**

MBA / PGDM in Human Resources Management, or MSW (Master of Social Work) with HR specialisation

**Experience**

0–3 years of relevant HR experience. Freshers with strong academic records and internship experience are encouraged to apply.

**Certifications (Desirable)**

SHRM\-CP, HRCI, or any recognised HR certification; Working knowledge of labour law compliance

**Skills \& Competencies**

**Technical / Functional Skills**

* Working knowledge of HR processes including recruitment, payroll, and performance management.
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) — Excel skills including VLOOKUP, pivot tables, and basic data analysis are essential.
* Familiarity with HRIS platforms (e.g., SAP HCM, Darwinbox, Zoho People, GreytHR, or similar).
* Basic understanding of Indian labour laws including PF, ESI, Gratuity, Shops \& Establishments Act, and the Employment Exchange Act.
* Ability to draft professional HR communications, circulars, and policy documents.

**Behavioural / Soft Skills**

* Strong communication skills — both written and verbal — with the ability to interact effectively with employees across all levels.
* High degree of confidentiality, integrity, and professional ethics.
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
* Attention to detail and accuracy in maintaining records and preparing reports.
* Proactive, self\-motivated attitude with a willingness to learn and adapt.
* Team player with a collaborative approach to working within a cross\-functional environment.
* Empathy and interpersonal sensitivity when dealing with employee concerns and grievances.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**KPI**

**Target**

Time\-to\-Fill (Recruitment)

≤ 30 working days per vacancy

Onboarding Completion Rate

100% within defined schedule

Payroll Input Accuracy

≥ 98% accuracy, zero payroll errors

Employee Query Resolution Time

≤ 48 hours for standard queries

Training Coordination

100% of planned programmes executed on schedule

HR Records Accuracy

Zero discrepancies in monthly HRIS audit

Compliance Documentation

100% statutory filings on time

Attrition Reporting

Monthly reports submitted within 5th of each month

**Working Conditions \& Benefits**

**Work Environment**

* Standard office environment at the Head Office.
* Five\-day working week with flexibility during peak recruitment or payroll cycles.
* Occasional travel to warehouse or retail store locations for HR audits, inductions, or employee engagement activities.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Competitive fixed CTC commensurate with qualifications and experience.
* Performance\-linked variable pay reviewed annually.
* Statutory benefits: PF, ESI, Gratuity as applicable.
* Health insurance (self \+ dependents) and group life insurance.
* Paid annual leave, casual leave, and sick leave as per company policy.
* Staff purchase discount on company footwear brands.
* Access to learning and development programmes and external training sponsorships.

description:
***OUR MISSION***




***At Redwood Software, we unleash human potential. We empower our customers with lights\-out automation for their mission\-critical business processes.***




  





***ABOUT US***




 Redwood Software is the leading orchestration platform for the autonomous enterprise, driving business transformation at the lowest total cost of ownership. Redwood empowers organizations to intelligently automate and orchestrate mission\-critical business and IT processes across complex ERP, hybrid cloud, data and emerging agentic AI systems. Through its SaaS\-first automation fabric—with AI embedded across the automation lifecycle—Redwood accelerates the path to autonomous operations. Backed by 30 years of experience and trusted by more than 50% of the Fortune 50, Redwood helps organizations unlock human potential to focus on innovation, growth and what’s next.
 



  





***CORE VALUES***




 One Team. One Redwood.
 



 Make Your Own Weather
 



 Obsess over Customer Success
 



 Work the Problem
 



 Be Curious
 



 Own the Outcome
 



 Respect Each Other
 



  





***YOUR IMPACT***




 We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Technical Writer to join our team and contribute to the development of clear, accurate, and user\-centric product documentation, In this role, you will leverage your understanding of workload automation, extensions and user needs to create and maintain documentation that empowers our users and aligns with business objectives for this innovative solution.
 


* Produce and maintain high\-quality, clear, and concise documentation for our workload automation products, including user manuals, implementation guides, API documentation, and release notes.
* Translate complex third\-party integrations, cloud services and technical features into easily understandable documentation tailored for various user personas.
* Collaborate closely with automation domain experts, engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to gather information, clarify requirements, and ensure the accuracy and completeness of technical documentation.
* Ensure documentation accurately reflects the latest product changes, releases, and enhancements, including updates to product functionalities and integrations.
* Work within a fast\-paced Agile development environment, adapting to evolving priorities and timelines while maintaining documentation quality.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of our documentation processes and workflows, incorporating best practices for clarity and accuracy in financial and technical content.
* Maintain a consistent style and tone across all documentation, adhering to established style guides and documentation standards.
* Incorporate user feedback and analytics to continuously improve documentation effectiveness and usability.
* Stay up to date with industry trends, tools, and best practices to improve the documentation process and deliver high\-quality content.



  





***YOUR EXPERIENCE***



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Technical Communication, English, or equivalent experience in a software development role combined with technical writing.
* 3\+ years of technical writing experience for complex B2B SaaS solutions, with demonstrated familiarity in software development, user personas, and tailored documentation.
* Proven experience creating technical documentation with tools such as MadCap Flare (or similar desktop\-based authoring tools), HTML, XML, and Javascript.
* An understanding of or experience practicing a Docs as Code framework (e.g., version control, plain text authoring).
* Exposure to or experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and lightweight markup (e.g., Markdown), demonstrating an adaptability towards modern documentation practices.
* Familiarity with project management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence) and API documentation tools (e.g., Swagger).
* Excellent written and verbal communication, strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
* Experience leveraging AI to improve documentation efficiency and quality.
* Technical experience with SAP, Docker, and Python scripting.

**About PhonePe Limited:**
 Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the PhonePe digital payments app, was launched in Aug 2016\. As of April 2025, PhonePe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40\+ million) merchants. PhonePe also processes over 33 Crore (330\+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore.
   

  

 PhonePe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance, Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode \- hyperlocal e\-commerce and Indus AppStore Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India, which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.
   

  

**Culture:**
 At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe\-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
   

  

**About:** 
 Phonepe is the leader in the UPI based payments in India with a market share of more than 47%. Our goal is to make payments so easy, safe and universally accepted that people never feel the need to carry cash or cards again. We believe India is at the cusp of a new mobile revolution, which will change the way we manage our money on the go. We see ourselves facilitating this change, through technology and dogged customer centricity. PhonePe went live in 2016 and till date has got over 600 mn registered users and 38 mn merchants. PhonePe has forayed into diverse areas with its offerings in all fintech segments including insurance, lending, mutual funds and stock broking. In 2024, PhonePe also launched Indus AppStore \- its own native Android\-based mobile app\-store built for Indian consumers providing app discovery and content in 12 Indian languages.
   

  

**Job Objective:** 
 Seeking a detail\-oriented HR Compliance Specialist for supporting the day\-to\-day operations related to various statutory compliances along with maintaining records, supporting inspections, and communicating with employees.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Regulatory Compliance:


 Coordinate with various internal and external stakeholders to ensure compliance with all statutory requirements pertaining to the labour laws .
   

  

 Ensure response to notices from the Government departments and submission of required data and timely filing of returns under various statutes help from PhonePe’s compliance partners.
   

  

 Coordination in preparation and dispatch of letters/ responses to notices received from the respective Government authorities/ departments.
   

  

 Maintain MIS for tracking various compliance related activities (dues, submissions, TAT, etc). Generating reports on compliance status, risks, issues and closures internal reviews.
   

  

* PF related Coordination and Employee Support:


 Handle and resolve PF related queries from employees in line with the prevalent guidelines.
   

  

 Supporting employees in submitting e\-JDs for correction of PF records.
   

  

 Guiding employees to file grievances on PF portal for resolution pending at departments.
   

  

 Ensuring compliances to PF e\-KYC and E\- nomination requirements by following up the respective employees.
   

  

 Assisting the nominees in filling and submitting death related claims.
   

  

* ESIC related Coordination and Employee Support:


 Ensuring timely and accurate monthly ESIC registrations and filings.
   

  

 Maintaining and updating the mandatory ESIC records, including registers and Form\-6, for ensuring 100% audit readiness for statutory inspections.
   

  

 Supporting employees with benefits and claims (sickness, maternity, accident reports) by coordinating with local ESIC offices (through the Compliance Partner) to ensure compliance.
   

  

* Documentation and Record\-Keeping:


 Maintain meticulous records of all compliance\-related activities \- registers, notices, responses, filings, and communications pertaining to the various statutes as required.
   

  

 Ensure that employee records and documentation are maintained as per statutory and audit requirements.
   

  

**Capabilities \& Requirements:**
* Bachelor's / Master’s degree in Human Resources, Labour Laws, Social work or related field.
* Knowledge of Labour Laws, regulations, guidelines, and procedures required for Compliances.

title: Office & HR Coordinator
description:
**Our Craft**
 Edrington’s vision is to give more by crafting exceptional ultra\-premium spirit brands. The Macallan is our central focus, supported by Highland Park and The Glenrothes in the single malt category. Our portfolio is completed with Brugal rum from the Dominican Republic, Wyoming Whiskey in the American Whiskey category and Valdespino sherry from Jerez in Spain. Edrington also has a strategic partnership with No.3 London Dry Gin.
   

  

 Our principal shareholder is a charitable trust, so we were built to make a world of difference. Discover a place where values define our culture. The home of exceptional brands, where people and teams thrive.
   

  

**Our Blend Of Benefits**
* Competitive Salary
* 23 days holiday, plus 7 days casual leave plus 4 Giving More volunteer days
* Provident fund contributions
* Private medical insurance
* Life Insurance
* Personal Accident Insurance
* 24/7 support for you and your loved ones to counselling, life coaching and information on financial, mental, and physical wellbeing
* Experience our exceptional brands with a generous annual product allowance
* Embrace work\-life harmony with hybrid working, 26 weeks’ paid maternity, paternity and adoption leave, and up to five paid carers leave days a year


**Embrace Excellence**
 This position acts as the first point of contact for visitors to the Edrington India office either in person through reception or over the telephone.  The role holder will be an Edrington ambassador by delivering an exceptional office coordination services to all visitors, guests and colleagues arriving and departing the office.
   

  

 The role holder will also support the HR Advisor and Compliance Officer in providing HR and administration service for Edrington India. Based in Gurgaon, the role reports to the Compliance Officer with a dotted line to the HR Advisor, based in Dubai.
   

  

 The role will predominantly support office administrative tasks such as event coordination, managing the visitor log and note taking during leadership team meetings however, the role will also be the first point of contact for India\-related HR queries and support the HR Advisor in ensuring all HR processes are fully compliant with India employment laws and local regulations.
   

  

**Make an Impact**
* Act as Front of House lead, managing visitors, reception activity, office facilities, meeting rooms, travel support, events, and overall workplace experience.
* Coordinate office administration and records, including databases, deliveries, invoicing, stationery, catering, and general operational support.
* Provide administrative support to HR and senior leadership, including diary management, expenses, note‑taking, and deputising for the HR Advisor when required.
* Maintain accurate HR systems and employee records (including Employee Central), ensuring data privacy, governance, and quality standards are met.
* Support India HR and labour compliance, maintaining statutory documentation, filing returns, supporting inspections, and liaising with authorities.
* Assist with employment lifecycle administration, including onboarding documentation, payroll inputs, benefits queries, and compliant exit processes.
* Support HR policy administration and local compliance reviews, ensuring alignment with Central and State legislation in India.
* Contribute to employee engagement, wellbeing, DE\&I, Giving More initiatives, and local learning and development activities.
* Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, supporting recruitment for junior roles and effective day‑to‑day HR operations.


**Your Talent And Skills**
 We’re looking for a confident and highly organised Office Coordinator with experience in a customer‑focused environment and a proven ability to manage multiple priorities with flexibility and attention to detail. You’ll be a strong communicator, comfortable working with stakeholders at all levels, and able to take ownership of tasks while maintaining a professional, helpful, and polished approach. Experience supporting HR systems or carrying out basic HR administration is important, with any knowledge of Indian employment or compliance legislation an advantage. Above all, you’ll have a strong work ethic, excellent customer service skills, and the discretion required to handle sensitive information.
   

  

 We’ve put together some criteria that we think is important for this role, but don’t worry if your experience and expertise isn’t an exact match. If you feel that you can add value to our role and to Edrington more broadly, we would welcome your application and be eager to learn more about you.
   

  

 \*Applications close 21st May 2026 at midnight\*
   

  

**A Place For Everyone**
 We’re proud of our inclusive culture – where unique experiences, ideas and perspectives are celebrated. We want everyone to feel respected and empowered to contribute to our success.
   

  

 Get involved. From colleague networks like Balance, Pride and Kick\-Start to inclusion allies and DE\&I champions, we encourage our people to be curious, get involved and help us make change happen.

title: Insights & client Success
description:
Role DNA \-
 



 This role is designed for someone early in their career who brings structure, ownership, and intellectual seriousness to every piece of work they touch. Alongside insight delivery, you'll support account management and contribute to solution design — but execution quality is the core. The ideal person here isn't looking for hand\-holding; they want early ownership and the chance to work at the intersection of research, AI, and client delivery.
 



  





**WHAT PROBLEM ARE THEY TRYING TO SOLVE?** 




 A platform automates data collection, analysis, and report generation — but the final mile requires human judgment, quality control, and structured communication to make outputs usable for demanding clients. The Associate is that last mile. As it scales its client base across consulting and PE firms globally, they need people who can maintain delivery quality at volume. The Associate also serves as a key feedback loop — working closely with clients and ML/product teams to identify where the platform needs to evolve and how new solutions should be designed.
 



  





**MUST HAVES** 



* 1–3 years in a research, consulting, analytics, or strategy role — or an exceptional fresher with demonstrably strong structured thinking
* Strong written and verbal communication; able to present clearly and professionally to clients at consulting or PE firms
* High ownership mentality — follows through without being chased, treats output quality as a personal standard
* Structured problem\-solver: can take an ambiguous brief, break it down, and deliver something coherent and well\-argued


1. Comfortable working with technology platforms and picking up new tools quickly — this is an AI\-powered product environment


* Genuine intellectual curiosity — wants to understand the 'why' behind a research question, not just complete the task



  





**STRONG SIGNAL** 



* Background in primary or secondary research, market intelligence, or data analytics
* Has produced client\-facing deliverables — decks, reports, briefs — even in an internship context
* Has worked with or alongside product or tech teams
* Comfortable synthesizing large datasets or qualitative inputs into a coherent narrative
* Experience with business terminology and comfort discussing commercial or strategic context with clients
* Prior exposure to B2B client environments — research firms, consulting, SaaS, or enterprise services
* Has contributed to building a process, template, or playbook, even at a junior level
* Fast learner with a track record of stepping up quickly in early roles



  





**WHAT DOES SUCCESS LOOK LIKE IN 60–90 DAYS?** 




**30 Days** 




 Has completed platform onboarding and can independently navigate Teamroom for core insight workflows. Has shadowed at least 2–3 client interactions and can articulate the brief, the output, and the client's expectations for each active engagement.
 



  





**60 Days** 




 Is delivering insight outputs with limited supervision, with quality that meets client expectations. Has flagged at least one process improvement or platform gap based on hands\-on experience. Is contributing meaningfully to client communication with appropriate polish.
 



  





**90 Days** 




 Is a trusted execution owner on assigned engagements. Can manage the end\-to\-end delivery of an insight workstream from brief to client output. Has contributed to at least one solution design or platform codification discussion. Is seen internally as a reliable, high\-ownership member of the team.

title: Presales Trainee
description:
**Pre\-Sales Trainee**


Location: **Mumbai**


Employment Type: **Full\-Time \| 5 Days a Week**


Who Should Apply: **Freshers \& Early\-Career Candidates (0\-1 Year)**


Probation Period: **6 Months, followed by confirmation as Pre\-Sales Associate**

  


**About the Role**


If you have been thinking \- I want to work in tech, but coding all day is not exactly my vibe \- this role was built for you. As a Pre\-Sales Trainee at Leapswitch, you will sit right at the intersection of technology and people: talking to real businesses, understanding their challenges, and presenting cloud solutions that genuinely help them.


You will work closely with our Sales and Technical teams, getting hands\-on exposure to products like CloudJiffy, CloudPe.com, and Bare\-Metal Servers. No prior experience required, just curiosity and a willingness to grow fast.

  


**What You'll Do**


* Join customer discovery calls to understand what problems businesses are trying to solve.
* Learn to present and demo our cloud products \- CloudJiffy, CloudPe.com, and Bare\-Metal Servers \- in a way that clicks for non\-technical buyers.
* Help build customised proposals, solution documents, and cost estimates tailored to each client.
* Support the team in preparing RFPs and RFI responses \- you will learn the full pre\-sales cycle.
* Coordinate with internal tech teams to get customer queries resolved quickly.
* Assist in proof\-of\-concept activities, guided by senior team members.
* Stay updated on trends in cloud computing, hosting, and virtualization.

  


Who We're Looking For


**You do not need to check every box \- but here is what will help:**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field (final year students may also apply).
* Freshers welcome \- internship or trainee experience in sales, tech support, or cloud is a bonus, not a must.
* Basic awareness of cloud concepts, servers, or networking \- even if self\-taught.
* Good communication skills \- written and verbal.
* Curious, proactive, and comfortable (or excited to become) in a customer\-facing role.

  


**Good to Have**


* Basic knowledge of Linux, Windows Server, or any cloud platform (AWS, GCP, Azure \- even beginner\-level counts).
* Interest in solution selling, customer interaction, and technical consulting.
* Ability to simplify complex technical concepts for a non\-technical audience.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving attitude.

  


**Probation \& Growth Path**


The role begins with a 6\-month probation period. We will evaluate your growth, communication, and role suitability. Perform well and you are confirmed \- with a clear path forward.


**Trainee \-\> Pre\-Sales Associate \-\> Senior Pre\-Sales**


**Why Join Leapswitch?**


* Real work from Day 1 \- customer calls, proposals, and demos within your first few weeks.
* Hands\-on exposure to live cloud products used by businesses across India.
* Mentorship from senior team members on demos, discovery, and deal strategy.
* Fast\-paced culture where good ideas are welcomed regardless of experience level.
* A defined growth path in a high\-demand domain \- cloud pre\-sales skills open doors everywhere.

 Excellent spoken and written English communication.

 Confident in speaking with international prospects.

 Experienced in outbound sales and B2B prospecting.

 Skilled at finding the right decision\-makers.

 Comfortable with USA and UK client communication.

 Strong in follow\-ups and relationship building.

 Professional in written communication, especially emails and LinkedIn messages.

 Custom software development

 CRM development

description:

 We are looking for a motivated AI/ML Engineering graduate to join our Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AIML) team. This role is ideal for a fresher with a strong academic foundation in AI/ML who is eager to apply theory to real world business problems under mentorship.
   

  

 You will work closely with senior AI/ML engineers, data scientists, and platform teams to build, experiment with, and operationalize machine learning solutions on enterprise scale data platforms.

title: Network Engineer – L2
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L2\) at NTT DATA, you'll take on a developing engineering role where your main goal is to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You'll achieve this by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. You'll work closely with our clients and internal teams to ensure that services are restored swiftly, in line with our service level agreements (SLAs).
   

  

 Your day will revolve around reviewing client requests and tickets, applying your technical expertise to resolve them efficiently and effectively. You'll be the go\-to person for second\-line support, handling incidents and requests of medium complexity. In addition to your daily tasks, you'll have opportunities to contribute to exciting project work from time to time.
   

  

 You'll proactively monitor work queues, execute operational tasks, and update tickets with the actions you've taken. Identifying, analysing, and logging issues before they escalate will be a key part of your role. You'll communicate with other teams and clients to provide support and ensure that changes are executed with clear risk identification and mitigation plans.
   

  

 As part of the shift handover process, you'll highlight key tickets and upcoming critical tasks for the next shift. When needed, you'll escalate tickets to ensure the right focus from our Centres of Excellence (CoE) and other teams. Collaborating with our automation teams, you'll work on optimizing efforts and automating routine tasks, all while coaching our Service desk and L1 teams in both technical and behavioural skills.
   

  

 You'll also establish monitoring for client infrastructure, leading and managing initial client escalations for operational issues. Contributing to the change management process, you'll log change requests, execute approved maintenance activities, and audit incident and request tickets for quality. Your insights will drive trend analysis reports, identifying tasks suitable for automation to reduce tickets and optimize efforts. You might also support disaster recovery functions and other related tasks as needed.
   

  

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**
* Proficiency in technologies such as Pulse Secure SSL VPN, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco Nexus switches/routers/firewalls, and more familiarity with ticketing tools.
* At least one technical certification in the above\-mentioned technologies.
* Strong planning skills, with the ability to anticipate and adapt to changing circumstances.
* Adaptability and resilience in a dynamic work environment.
* Ability to communicate and work effectively across different cultures and social groups.
* Proficiency in active listening and client\-centric communication.
* A positive outlook and the ability to work well under pressure.
* A client\-first attitude, always seeking to create positive client experiences.
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT/Computing, or equivalent work experience.

Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R\&D.

 NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

At PwC, our people in infrastructure focus on designing and implementing robust, secure IT systems that support business operations.  Focused on relationships, you are building meaningful client connections, and learning how to manage and inspire others. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, and to deliver quality.
