title: Sr Validation Engineer
description:
**Company Description**  

Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world\-leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.


Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics and the world.

 **Job Description**  

Senior Engineer Validation role is and IC role which requires 5\+ years of experience of Bench Validation and Debug of Power Management ICs as part of 2\.6B$ Power Business Unit at Renesas. Primary responsibilities include fully own Bench Validation, Silicon Debugs, Automation of Equipment and Tests of PMICs. Will also be responsible for analysing the data, documenting and reporting findings to the Systems team and work closely with Design \& Systems experts to ensure quality ICs. The role also involves opportunity to technically lead a small team with ownership of doing end to end IC validatation.


The candidate should be able to develop and automate industry standard tests which are done for switching converters. In addition, the candidate should be able to define the equipment requirements for testing Power Management ICs and help setup lab from scratch. Ability to debug setups, equipment related issues and identify solutions is a must. The candidate needs to minimize Bench Testing cost while ensuring high quality in testing by employing standardization, reuse and automation.

**Responsibilities:**

* Maximise utilisation of Benches, equipment and resources through automation and industry best practices.
* Write bench test programs in Python, C and be able to debug ATE programs. Work with a mindset of smart work, collaboration with rest of the team
* In this technical role, candidate must be very strong hands on and should also be able to technically coach/mentor/ramp up new college graduates and freshers.
* Project the schedule for bench test program development, testing and debug based on the infrastructure and resource availability and identify gaps/risks for execution.
* Ownership and Accountability for accuracy, quality and presentation of all deliverables (waveforms, reports, documentation, results etc).
* Technically lead bench validation and debug of multiple PMICs out of Bengaluru, while working with design/systems teams which located at different geographies and in different time zones.
* Expertise of using Validation related equipment including various types of Power Supplies, Load Slammer, Scopes and probes, Multi\-meters, Analog switches, Relays, Computer to IC board communications etc.
* Must have experience of defining and driving Bench Validation plan for Power Management ICs and Evaluation Boards.
* Must be fluent with using FPGAs for testing Digital and emulating system behaviour.
* Must have experience with ATE\-Bench correlation and should be able to drive that independently.
* Should be well versed with one or more Power Chip Communication protocols e.g. SPMI, PMBUS, SVI3, SVID etc. Should be comfortable with I2C.
* Should be able to create basic circuits on bread board for experimentation.
* Good to have board design experience.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in Bench Validation of Mixed Signal ICs, especially PMICs .
* Ability to work with clarity and predictable timelines to ensure deliverables with high quality.
* Cross cultural awareness and sensitivity.
* Results\-oriented and able to deliver on\-time under tight schedule pressure.

  

**Additional Information**  

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose ‘**To Make Our Lives Easier**.’ As the industry’s leading expert in embedded processing with unmatched quality and system\-level know\-how, we have evolved to provide scalable and comprehensive semiconductor solutions for automotive, industrial, infrastructure, and IoT industries based on the broadest product portfolio, including High Performance Computing, Embedded Processing, Analog \& Connectivity, and Power.  

  

With a diverse team of over 21,000 professionals in more than 30 countries, we continue to expand our boundaries to offer enhanced user experiences through digitalization and usher into a new era of innovation. We design and develop sustainable, power\-efficient solutions today that help people and communities thrive tomorrow, ‘**To Make Our Lives Easier**.’  

  

At Renesas, you can:

* **Launch and advance your career** in technical and business roles across four Product Groups and various corporate functions. You will have the opportunities to explore our hardware and software capabilities and try new things.
* **Make a real impact** by developing innovative products and solutions to meet our global customers' evolving needs and help make people’s lives easier, safe and secure.
* **Maximize your performance and wellbeing** in our flexible and inclusive work environment. Our people\-first culture and global support system, including the remote work option and Employee Resource Groups, will help you excel from the first day.


Are you ready to own your success and make your mark?


Join Renesas. Let’s **Shape the Future** together.


Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity \& Inclusion Statement.


We have adopted a hybrid model that gives employees the ability to work remotely two days a week while ensuring that we come together as a team in the office the rest of the time. The designated in\-office days are Tuesday through Thursday for innovation, collaboration and continuous learning.

title: PROJECT MANAGER L1
description:
Job Description* 
Job Title: PROJECT MANAGER L1
City: Bengaluru
State/Province: Karnataka
Posting Start Date: 5/6/26
Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future\-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever\-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.
Job Description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

  

**Role**

The purpose of the role is to manage delivery of a project driving operations and delivery governance, ensuring right talent supply chain to optimize customer satisfaction and cost of delivery


**͏**
-----

**Do**

* Delivery Management
* Ensure seamless delivery of the projects
* Deploy optimum project delivery structure post transition/ migration phase by evaluating the budget, costs, risks and staffing requirement
* Create quarterly project charter with well\-defined weekly project trajectory as per the project specifications \& requirements and ensure 100% adherence in terms of schedule, quality, efforts and costs

  

* Ensure 100% compliance to Project SLAs, information security protocols and etc (all customers contractual obligations)
* Monitor and take appropriate actions on internal and external audit findings to ensure no major non\-compliance/ deviation from the SLA
* Liaise between customer and internal technical delivery team to drive project health by adhering to organizational norms of project metrics
* Drive various project related audits like quality, customer, ISO etc and ensure zero non\-compliance
* Conduct periodic cadence with the quality team to take proactive measures to resolves issues/ possible escalations
* Conducts periodic cadence with Workforce Management Group (WMG) to ensure 100% fulfillment as per the program/ project requirement
* Regularly audit quality (QA) status of delivery and engage QA team to ensure adherence to Quality Assurance standards and processes
* Maintain project structure in Confluence \& SAP in line with prevailing business requirements and norms
* Ensure expected ramp down (ERD) compliance as committed in MSA
* Client Relationship Management
* Engage with client to deploy opportunities to deploy multiple solutions within/ across SLs to create a stronger value proposition for clients

\- Conduct regular customer connects (meetings/ visits/ video\- conference) and participate in Management Review Meetings (MRM) with client management/engagement managers to understand customers current and future needs and seek feedback to improve delivery methodology/ timelines/ resource allocation
* Identify and close early warnings on a project to avoid any customer escalations
* Plan and conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) along with DMs/ ADH with the client management/ leadership team to drive improvement actions and mine for a new portfolio/ opportunity within the account
* Design and monitor project performance dashboards/ reports with the clients periodically
* Delivery governance across the project
* Create weekly/ monthly/ quarterly MIS and reports to monitor and track overall project
* Conduct periodic reviews with the delivery team on operational, quality and fulfillment parameters and new idea generation \& its implementation on existing projects
* Identify and resolve potential risks or early warning signs on project delivery to drive for ZERO surprise escalations and eliminate any revenue leakage
* Escalate any deviations from the project charter to the delivery managers in terms of schedule, effort, cost, infrastructure from the project charter and minimize process exceptions and such deviations from the actual project plan
* Review and monitor revenue allocations/ realization to avoid OB revenue leakage
* Provide inputs to delivery leadership team on overall delivery performance parameters (project heath, utilization, realization etc) at project/ program level during reviews highlighting any critical project escalations and potential risks
**͏**
-----

* Operational Excellence
* Automation Focus
* Perform pareto analysis as per the no. of incidents received and accordingly identify automation opportunities and drive value adds across the project
* Deploy next generation hyper automation and crowdsourcing initiatives in coordination with Holmes RO team to enhance productivity, quality and speed of delivery

  

* Interact and engage with tools team to bring in new tools in the project to automate certain pointers/ elimination of any noise in the project
* Innovation Focus
* Brainstorm with the team to identify improvement opportunities and initiatives to further improve quality, delivery speed and productivity parameters
* Drive value adds and BVMs; ensure management showcases them to customer in MRM \& QBR to drive growth
* Plan and conduct periodic idea campaigns to generate new solutions to the problems/ define better ways of working
* Drive and deploy Knowledge Management and sharing
* Contribute in internal knowledge sharing initiatives at Wipro by driving internal training sessions, best practices, learnings, value adds and BVMs and deploys best practices in various projects within own account
* Deploy the Wipro's knowledge management portal across the account and monitor \& track trainings
* Capability Development and Talent Pipeline Creation
* Demand forecasting in line with business requirements
* Anticipate attrition and ensure right talent supply chain to deliver the project
* Spearhead quarterly demand forecasting and resource planning aligned to project requirements

  

* Create and deploy a workplan to fulfil the required demand from all the talent channels including external (lateral, contractors etc) hiring in coordination with WMG/ CWMG and Talent Acquisition team
* Anticipate new skills/ upcoming technologies required to deliver the project and ensure the team is trained or right talent is inducted into the project as per the skill requirements
* Drive 100% compliance on trainings and upskilling requirements
* Prioritize and identify essential and upcoming technical skills required across programs/ projects to facilitate and drive right supply chain
* Drive towards 100% mandatory training compliance for the target population within an account
* Plan and drive rotations for seed positions and ensure replacement plan to be arrived ahead of rotations
* Quarterly connect with critical talent to understand their career aspirations and create their learning maps along with project managers and HRBP
* Fresher engagement program
* Ensure a stable arrangement and assimilation of rookie within accounts in coordination with competency group team (classroom trainings/ e\-learning, certifications, on the job training etc)
* Team Management
* Resourcing
* Forecast talent requirements as per the current and future business needs
* Hire adequate and right resources for the team
* Talent Management
* Ensure adequate onboarding and training for the team members to enhance capability \& effectiveness
* Build an internal talent pool and ensure their career progression within the organization

  

* Manage team attrition
* Drive diversity in leadership positions
* Performance Management
* Set goals for the team, conduct timely performance reviews and provide constructive feedback to own direct reports
* Ensure that the Performance Nxt is followed for the entire team
* Employee Satisfaction and Engagement
* Lead and drive engagement initiatives for the team
* Track team satisfaction scores and identify initiatives to build engagement within the team
* Facilitate rewards and recognition to acknowledge the high performers in the team
**͏**
-----

Deliver  



  

1\.
  

  

Delivery Management ÃÂ¢Ã¢ÂÂ¬Ã¢ÂÂ Client satisfaction
  

  

PCSAT, Brand score, no. of customer references, SDR/ QBR %, Pulse % satisfied (top 2 box), Zero surprise delivery escalation from the customer, adherence to project charter
  

  

2\.
  

  

Delivery Management ÃÂ¢Ã¢ÂÂ¬Ã¢ÂÂ operational efficiency
  

  

Contractual adherence %, Quality index, Utilization %, cost of delivery target, overdue indent, 100% SLA compliance, PEI % target, 100% usage of click to bill, % SAP loss for T\&M projects
  

  

3\.
  

  

Delivery Management ÃÂ¢Ã¢ÂÂ¬Ã¢ÂÂ Financials
  

  

Revenue target achievement, Operating margin %, leakage from OB to revenue, revenue per employee, CR realization target, process exceptions to be minimized, bench cost % of total cost, underrun % target for FPP projects, effort saving through NG\-1, NG\-2 initiatives
  

  

5\.
  

  

Capability Building
  

  

% attrition, critical talent attrition%, % trained on new age skills, % of team trained in necessary behavioural skills, diversity ratio, % localization targets by market, billable rookie ratio, rookie/NJNB assimilation TATs, offshore mix
  

  

6\.
  

  

Team Management
  

  

Team attrition %, Employee satisfaction score  

  



**͏**
-----

Mandatory Skills: Project Management .  

Experience: 8\-10 Years .

Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

description:

Matrix fully integrates software and hardware across its products. Engineers here collaborate more effectively to create solutions that solve real problems and make an impact. We are responsible for every nut, bolt, and line of code in our products!

Role : Engineer/ Sr. Engineer \- Hardware Design (Schematic)


Function : Hardware Design \- (Schematic)


Work Location : Vadodara, Gujarat

 **Who are you**


You are an energetic and passionate individual with extensive expertise in hardware design, particularly in schematic design. You possess a deep understanding of various hardware components and systems, including IP cameras, video recorders, access control systems, smart card readers, IP terminals, PABX, GSM gateways, military\-grade cameras and recorders, and explosion\-proof cameras. You thrive on tackling complex challenges and are driven by a commitment to innovation and excellence in hardware design.

  

Experience : 1 \- 5 Years (Freshers can also apply)


Qualification : B.E/ B.tech/ M.E/ M.tech (EC, Electronics \& Communication) OR MSc (EC/Electronics)

 **Technical Skills Required :**

* Experience on all stages of Hardware Product Development Lifecycle.
* Development of high speed board design in embedded domain.
* Should have hands\-on experience of Schematic design.
* Experience on all stages of the Hardware Product Development Lifecycle.
* Designing and developing components such as printed circuit boards (PCB), processors, memory modules, and network components.
* Experience on High\-Speed Interfaces like DDR, Memory, Audio, USB, Ethernet (Experience on HDMI, SATA, MIPI, CSI, USB, I2C, SPI will be additional benefit).

* Create schematic diagrams following engineering layout principles and industry standards

* Integration with other engineering departments for product definition (System design, Schematic and Layout integration, upfront work with vendor team).
* Oversee design and testing related management with structural workflow.
* Product certification support like CE, FCC and other safety standards
* Work on high\-speed interfaces such as RGMII, MIPI\-DSI, PCIe Gen3, MIPI\-CSI, eMMC, and USB 3\.0 to ensure seamless integration and performance.

 **What we offer**

* Opportunity to work for an Indian Tech Company creating incredible products for the world, right from India
* Be part of a challenging, encouraging, and rewarding environment to do the best work of your life
* Competitive salary and other benefits
* Generous leave schedule of 21 days in addition to 9 public holidays, including holiday adjustments to convert weekends into long weekends
* 5\-day workweek with 8 flexi\-days months, allowing you to take care of responsibilities at home and work
* Company\-paid Medical Insurance for the whole family (Employee\+Spouse\+Kids\+Parents). Company paid Accident Insurance for the Employee
* On\-premise meals, subsidized by the company

  

If you are an Innovative Tech\-savvy individual, Look no further. Click on Apply and we will reach out to you soon!

title: Respiratory Therapy Specialist - Apprentice - Chennai
description:
Respiratory Therapy Specialist \- Apprentice \- Chennai


**Date:** May 6, 2026
**Location:**Bengaluru, IN
**Company:** Getinge Medical India Pvt. Ltd.
**Remote Work:** Field
**With a passion for life**

Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life\-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.
Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.**Job Overview**

The Respiratory Therapist Specialist – Apprentice program is designed for fresh graduates aspiring to build a career in respiratory care and mechanical ventilation technology. As part of a leading healthcare/medical device organization, the apprentice will receive intensive training on mechanical ventilators, CPAP/BiPAP systems, and other respiratory care devices while supporting clinical teams in hospitals.

This is a structured learning role with strong exposure to real\-world clinical workflows, device handling, and interaction with ICU/critical care staff.  


**Job Responsibilities and Essential Duties**  


**Clinical \& Technical Learning**
* Learn the fundamentals of mechanical ventilation, respiratory parameters, and device operations.
* Assist senior respiratory therapists and application specialists during ventilator demonstrations, installations, and clinical support sessions.
* Observe and assist with ventilator setup, configuration, and monitoring in ICU, NICU, PICU, and emergency settings.
* Understand different ventilation modes (e.g., Volume Control, Pressure Control, SIMV, CPAP).


**Application \& Customer Support**
* Support in conducting product demos and hands\-on training for clinicians and nurses.
* Assist in troubleshooting basic device issues under guidance from senior team members.
* Learn how to document feedback, clinical observations, and usage patterns from hospitals.


**Device Management \& Compliance**
* Help in performing routine checks, preventive maintenance, and performance assessments of ventilators.
* Ensure proper cleaning, handling, and safety protocols for all respiratory devices.
* Follow company SOPs, regulatory guidelines, and hospital infection control norms.


**Training \& Certification**
* Participate in structured internal training programs on respiratory therapy and ventilator technology.
* Complete skill assessments, modules, and certification milestones during the apprenticeship period.

  


**Minimum Requirements**
* **Education (Freshers Only):** Bachelor’s Degree in: Respiratory Therapy / Respiratory Care


**Preferred Knowledge**
* Basic understanding of Human Respiratory physiology
* Interest in mechanical ventilation and critical care devices
* Comfort working in hospital/ICU environments

  


**Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**
* Strong learning mindset and passion for respiratory care
* Good communication and interpersonal skills for hospital interactions
* Technical curiosity for medical devices and technology
* Ability to work under supervision in fast paced clinical settings
* Willingness to travel locally for hospital visits


**Benefits \& Growth Opportunities**  


* Hands\-on training with advanced ventilator systems and respiratory technology
* Exposure to real hospital environments, ICU workflows, and critical care teams
* Mentorship from experienced respiratory therapists and application experts
* Certificate of Apprenticeship upon completion
* Strong career pathway into:
* Respiratory Therapist
* Application Specialist – Ventilators
* Clinical Specialist – Critical Care
* Product Trainer / Clinical Educator
* Technical Support Specialist (Medical Devices)

  


**About the Apprenticeship Program**

This apprenticeship is built to develop future\-ready respiratory care professionals who can operate confidently in critical care environments and support hospitals with advanced ventilator solutions. The program blends classroom learning, field exposure, and supervised clinical practice.**About us**

With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

title: IP Admin Analyst
description:
We are looking for someone to join our IP Admin Team at Noida. This position exists to process correspondences issued by United States Patent \& Trademark office (PTO or USPTO), patent offices worldwide and the filing documents submitted in PTO during the patent \& trademarks life cycle. The main purpose of the role is to review, docket, de\-docket information received from PTOs, law firms, agents, and clients into Intellectual property management system (IPMS) and routing the said information to the appropriate attorneys or paralegals for action.


This is an exciting opportunity to work in the IP field where\-in, self\-improvement initiatives to drive client delight, building capability are added learnings.


We are the largest Intellectual Property Administrative service provider.

 **Experience, Education, Skills, and Accomplishments**

  

* B.Sc. / M.Sc. B.Com, BBA, BCA, BA, MBA graduates with minimum 50% aggregate
* Freshers from 2025\-2026 Batch
* Experienced candidates should have a minimum of 18 months of work experience in Backend Operations
* Confident and proactive team player, with good interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently and efficiently with minimum / no supervision.

 **It would be great if you also had . . .**

  

* IP Knowledge with experience to work on different IPMS' is added advantage and preferable.
* Good written \& verbal communication skills
* Basic MS office: Proficiency in Microsoft office suite programs, including Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Strong analytical skills to comprehensively evaluate the data.

 **What will you be doing in this role?**

  

* Docketing: calendaring the statutory \& non\-statutory deadlines in Intellectual Property Management System (IPMS) along with relevant documents to preserve IP rights.
* De\-docketing: perform or close the calendared events in IPMS once the requisite action is completed or cancelled, respectively.
* Prioritize daily docketing/de\-docketing requests and other allocated tasks as agreed with client to complete in each day to keep IPMS current and correct.
* Review patent \& trademarks prosecution related documents (US \& Non\-US) received via mail or shared site and update / create the records in IPMS as per the standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Create and update patent \& trademarks records in IPMS along with family linking of direct and subject matter related (SMR) applications.
* Effective communication with Attorneys, Paralegals, Law firms, foreign agents, and other stake holders to seek instructions and clarification on certain tasks.
* Maintain the data integrity of IPMS and proactively monitoring the docket to ensure that all PTO \& client deadlines are met.
* Facilitate timely filing of all patent and trademarks application \& office action response through order letters and other required instructions.
* Facilitate accurate and timely payment of all PTO fees including the maintenance fees, coordinate with client for payment instructions and coordinate with annuity service providers or law firms.
* Abreast of changes in PTO guidelines and procedures and extend support to team with process related inputs.
* Training: Providing OJT’s to new joiners, conducting refresher trainings.
* Audits: Ability to perform internal and PTO Audits is preferred
* Quality Check: Should be able perform docketing Quality audits
* 1st level query resolution

 **About the Team**


The team consists of 10\-15 members and is reporting to the Manager Operations.


Core process related responsibilities: IP docketing is the process of tracking deadlines related to the prosecution of patents, trademarks, and copyrights before their respective governing offices. This includes interacting with clients including external vendors \- Law firms, Annuity service providers etc., Quality Auditors, IP Operations function heads, Continuous Improvement team.

 **Hours of Work**

* You will be working for works 40 hours/week (9 hrs a day; 5 days a week); you are entitled to get Overtime if you work beyond your working hours.
* This is a permanent job role.

title: Manager, Analog Design
description:
**Job Description**

  

Looking for a 10\+ years experienced Engineering Manager with in\-depth understanding of Analog concepts, experience of design of complex Analog I/Ps \& sub\-blocks, integrating I/Ps and sub systems and ownership, experience of fully owning smaller ICs (Point of loads, Single Converters) and owning major I/Ps in large PMICs, to join the 2\.6B$ Power Business Unit. The candidate will get to work on a wide range of exciting products such as PMICs, Linear and Switching DC\-DC converters powering the next generation of Renesas processors. This is an early\-stage growth opportunity where in the candidate will get to learn, build and over time contribute and influence the charter for Renesas’s massive Power product portfolio.


Essential Functions:

* Must be proficient in designing and owning complex I/Ps like \+ve/\-ve Charge Pumps, Buck Converters, Source\-Sink LDOs, Ultra\-low power Oscillators (including Relaxation type), Temperature Sensor, Current Sense, SAR ADCs, Protection (Thermal, Under\-Voltage, Over\-Voltage, Over Current etc) and analog blocks including Bandgap references, V2I, Analog Buffers, Op\-Amps, Comparators, High speed level shifters etc.
* Must have in\-depth Understanding of and should be able to implement \& compensate the Control Loops, Analog feedback loops and should know trade\-offs between various compensation strategies.
* Should be able to build/support Block level spec break down from Top level chip requirements and independently own, design complete switching converter e.g. Buck, Boost, Buck\-Boost etc and LDOs. Must be able to do block level error budgeting depending on the block requirements.
* Must be aware of relative differences of various control loop architectures (Constant Freq, Constant ON/OFF Time, Current mode etc) and decide/implement the best option to meet converter level performance specifications and other system requirements.
* Must be able to bring in innovative ideas to improve designs to meet challenging specifications.
* Should have in\-depth knowledge of Analog layouts and be able to work closely with layout lead from floor planning till Chip Top completion and verification and do trade\-offs based on desired performance
* Must be conversant with the standard design, extraction and simulation flows \& tools, speed, convergence, accuracy trade\-offs and should be able to optimize setups based on Pre/Post (with/without) Parasitic using simulator options, debug and navigate through tool related challenges.
* Should be able to setup design flows and methodologies including checklists, reviews to ensure quality designs and take them all the way to Silicon success.
* Should be able to mentor Freshers and Junior engineers for upscaling their technical skills as well as other skills needed for better efficacy.
* Should have experience of end\-to\-end IC development flow, Silicon debugs, and taking ICs to production
* Should be able to lead/manage a small group of Engineers and navigate through all stages of IC development while handling and mitigating challenges, ensuring high quality silicon while adhering to the schedules based on business needs.
* Should have in\-depth understanding of ESD, LU and other IC level issues and be able to define protection for the I/O ring for the IC

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering
* 10\+ years in Analog Circuit Design, minimum 2 years of managerial experience.
* Solid understanding and design experience of complex analog designs with full ownership.
* Chip design, Verification, Silicon validation, debugs, Qual support and taking ICs to production.
* Must be a technical leader and natural team player, mentor and should strive towards fostering a highly creative and productive working environment

 **Company Description**

  

Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.


Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics and the world.

 **Additional Information**

  

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose ‘**To Make Our Lives Easier**.’ As the industry’s leading expert in embedded processing with unmatched quality and system\-level know\-how, we have evolved to provide scalable and comprehensive semiconductor solutions for automotive, industrial, infrastructure, and IoT industries based on the broadest product portfolio, including High Performance Computing, Embedded Processing, Analog \& Connectivity, and Power.  

  

With a diverse team of over 21,000 professionals in more than 30 countries, we continue to expand our boundaries to offer enhanced user experiences through digitalization and usher into a new era of innovation. We design and develop sustainable, power\-efficient solutions today that help people and communities thrive tomorrow, ‘**To Make Our Lives Easier**.’  

  

At Renesas, you can:

* **Launch and advance your career** in technical and business roles across four Product Groups and various corporate functions. You will have the opportunities to explore our hardware and software capabilities and try new things.
* **Make a real impact** by developing innovative products and solutions to meet our global customers' evolving needs and help make people’s lives easier, safe and secure.
* **Maximize your performance and wellbeing** in our flexible and inclusive work environment. Our people\-first culture and global support system, including the remote work option and Employee Resource Groups, will help you excel from the first day.


Are you ready to own your success and make your mark?


Join Renesas. Let’s **Shape the Future** together.


Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our **Diversity \& Inclusion Statement**.

**Role Objective**

**MECHANICAL ENGINEER – JOB DESCRIPTION**

Location: Surat

Department: Production

Reports To: Production Manager / Production Head

Experience: 0–1 Year

Job Type: Full\-time

JOB SUMMARY

We are seeking a highly motivated and technically proficient Mechanical Engineer for our Textile Printing Machine Manufacturing Division. The role involves supporting end\-to\-end production operations, including machine assembly, fabrication coordination, production planning, process monitoring, quality assurance, and continuous improvement initiatives. The role demands a strong technical understanding of industrial machine manufacturing, mechanical systems, and structured production execution.

The ideal candidate should possess sound engineering fundamentals, strong analytical capabilities, and the ability to perform effectively in a high\-precision manufacturing environment.

KEY ROLES \& RESPONSIBILITIES

* Execute and monitor day\-to\-day production activities related to the manufacturing and assembly of textile printing machinery in accordance with approved production plans.
* Coordinate the assembly of Rotary Printing Machines, Flatbed Printing Machines, Laser Engraving Systems, and Digital Textile Printers while ensuring adherence to engineering specifications and quality benchmarks.
* Supervise fabrication, machining, fitting, alignment, and final assembly processes to ensure dimensional accuracy, functional reliability, and production efficiency.
* Review mechanical drawings, General Arrangement (GA) drawings, Bill of Materials (BOM), assembly instructions, and production schedules prior to execution.
* Ensure optimum utilization of manpower, machinery, tools, and production resources to achieve targeted output and timely project completion.
* Identify and resolve mechanical assembly challenges including fitment deviations, alignment discrepancies, vibration issues, and performance\-related concerns during production stages.
* Coordinate closely with Design, Electrical, Fabrication, Stores, Procurement, and Quality departments to ensure seamless workflow and production continuity.
* Conduct in\-process inspections and monitor compliance with established manufacturing standards and quality parameters.
* Support machine testing, dry trials, performance validation, and final inspection activities prior to machine dispatch.
* Maintain accurate production documentation including daily production reports, job progress status, rejection analysis, downtime records, and productivity reports.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives aimed at reducing rework and improving manufacturing efficiency.
* Ensure strict adherence to shop floor safety practices, 5S implementation, and company SOPs.

KEY SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

* Strong understanding of industrial machine manufacturing processes, fabrication methodologies, and precision assembly systems.
* Sound knowledge of textile printing machine architecture, including Rotary Printing Systems, Flatbed Machines, Laser Engraving Equipment, and Digital Textile Printing Solutions.
* Proficiency in interpreting mechanical drawings, fabrication layouts, assembly drawings, GA drawings, and Bill of Materials (BOM).
* Working knowledge of mechanical transmission systems, including shafts, bearings, rollers, gear assemblies, gearboxes, pneumatic systems, and motion transfer mechanisms.
* Familiarity with production planning, process flow optimisation, machine trial procedures, and in\-process quality assurance practices.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills for resolving production bottlenecks and mechanical non\-conformities.
* Basic proficiency in AutoCAD and production documentation systems will be considered an added advantage.
* Effective coordination and communication skills for managing cross\-functional production activities and technical discussions.
* Strong discipline in reporting, execution, and shop floor supervision within a structured manufacturing environment.
* Ability to perform under production deadlines while maintaining quality, safety, and operational excellence.

QUALIFICATIONS

* Education: Diploma or Degree in Mechanical Engineering

We’re looking for a fresher/junior web developer to help us build and improve the web product for an AI\-based application. You’ll work closely with the core team to ship features, fix bugs, and make the UI feel clean and smooth. If you’ve built even 1–2 solid projects (college/hackathon/internship) and you’re comfortable learning fast, you’ll do well here.

**Responsibilities**

Build and improve web pages (dashboard, upload pages, admin tools, etc.)

Turn Figma designs into responsive UI that looks polished

Connect the frontend to backend APIs (auth, data, uploads, results, etc.)

Handle basic edge cases properly (bad inputs, empty states, failures)

Fix bugs quickly and write changes in a way that doesn’t break other parts

Keep code organized (reusable components, clean structure)

Use Git properly (branches, PRs, reviews)

Write short documentation when needed (setup steps, what you changed, anything tricky)

**Requirements**

Comfortable with HTML, CSS, JavaScript

Some experience with React (or you can pick it up quickly)

Understands how to work with APIs (fetching data, handling errors, loading states)

Has worked on at least one AI/ML\-related project or feature (even a small one is fine)

Basic Git knowledge and willingness to work in a PR workflow

Good attitude: takes ownership, communicates clearly, and doesn’t disappear mid\-task

AI Experience (what counts)

**Any of these is enough:**

Built a small ML project (classification / NLP / recommender / etc.)

Used OpenAI / HuggingFace / LangChain in a project

Displayed model outputs on a UI (labels, scores, summaries, etc.)

Understands basic terms like accuracy, precision/recall, training vs inference

Nice to Have

TailwindCSS / Bootstrap

TypeScript basics

Flask/FastAPI familiarity

Basic database knowledge (Postgres/Supabase/Firebase)

Good UI sense (spacing, typography, responsiveness)

Some deployment exposure (Vercel/Render/Docker)

What Success Looks Like

UI looks clean and works well on both laptop and mobile screens

API integrations are reliable and don’t feel “janky”

Bugs get fixed properly (not just quick hacks)

Code stays readable as the product grows

You’re shipping improvements consistently every week

Work Setup

description:
Equity Analyst – Fresher

We are looking for a **fresher Equity Analyst** who is eager to learn, research\-oriented, and comfortable working with financial data on a daily basis. This role is ideal for someone who wants to build a career in equity research and learn stock analysis on the job.

Job Responsibilities

* Track daily stock price movement and important market developments.
* Monitor insider buying, preferential issues, bulk/block deals, and other corporate actions.
* Read and understand company financial statements, including:
* Balance Sheet
* Profit \& Loss Account
* Cash Flow Statement
* Analyze basic valuation and financial ratios such as:
* P/E ratio
* Market Capitalization
* Debt levels
* EBITDA
* Margin trends
* Support research on listed companies and prepare simple notes or summaries.
* Keep track of news, announcements, and events that may impact stock performance.
* Maintain records, trackers, and watchlists in Excel or Google Sheets.

* Willingness to learn quickly and work independently.
* Good analytical and observation skills.
* Comfortable using Excel/Google Sheets.
* Strong attention to detail.

Preferred Skills

* Knowledge of price\-volume action and basic technical analysis.
* Understanding of chart patterns, trends, support/resistance.
* Familiarity with market terminology and corporate announcements.
* Any exposure to financial research, trading, or investing will be an advantage.

Qualification

* Fresher / Recent graduate.
* Commerce, Finance, Economics, or related background preferred, but not mandatory if interest and aptitude are strong.

What We Offer

* Hands\-on learning in equity research.
* Exposure to real market tracking and stock analysis.
* Opportunity to grow into a full\-time research role.
* Guidance from experienced team members.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is curious, disciplined, and genuinely interested in learning the stock market. The role requires consistency, eagerness to learn, and the ability to understand company data and market behavior over time.

description:
**Join CellPoint Digital: Shape the Future of Payments with Us!** 








 At CellPoint Digital, we’re revolutionizing the way businesses in the air, travel, and hospitality sectors manage their payments. 
 







 With our
 **Leading Payment Orchestration Platform** 
 , we’re turning payments into a strategic advantage, helping clients optimize their payment experience to boost profits, maximize approvals, lower costs and take control of their payment, resulting in more money to the bottom line.
 







 We believe payments should be a
 **strategic asset** 
 , delivering financial, customer, and operational value. Our vision is to unify the payment ecosystem, opening up a world of opportunities for leading brands in the air, travel, and hospitality industries. We transform the payment supply chain from a cost center into a
 **profit engine** 
 , turning every transaction into an opportunity for growth and competitive advantage.
 







 At our core,
 **we're innovators** 
 and
 **problem\-solvers** 
 united by five key values: Mission First, Ownership, Trust \& Transparency, Driven, and One Team. We're ambitious professionals who embrace accountability and transform payments together.
 







 Our diverse community spans the globe, with hubs in Copenhagen, Dallas, Dubai, London, Miami, Pune, Buenos Aires, Bogota, Mexico, and Singapore, along with remote team members worldwide. We celebrate the unique perspectives and experiences that make our team extraordinary.
 







 Join us as an
 **HR Intern** 
 on our mission to turn payments into possibilities!
 







**HR Intern** 




 As an HR Intern, you will be a key support pillar for our Senior HR Business Partner, focusing on high\-growth recruitment and ensuring a world\-class experience for our team in India. 
 



  

**How You Will Make an Impact:** 



* **End\-to\-End Interview Coordination:** 
 Take full ownership of coordinating diaries and scheduling interviews for live roles, managing complex calendars across multiple time zones.
* **Seamless Onboarding Support:** 
 Work closely with internal IT and Ops teams to ensure all hardware, software, and system access are ready and waiting for new joiners on day one.
* **Office Culture \& Engagement:** 
 Plan and facilitate creative engagement activities for the India office in collaboration with the Sr HRBP to foster a high\-performance, connected community.
* **Data \& ATS Integrity:** 
 Maintain accurate records within our Applicant Tracking System and assist in compiling recruitment analytics to track hiring progress.
* **Generalist Admin Support:** 
 Provide proactive administrative assistance to the Lead HRBP and Sr HRBP on global people projects and local compliance tasks as appropriate.



 What makes CellPoint Digital a leader in the payment landscape isn’t just our technology \- it’s our people and how we work together. We’ve built a global community where diverse talents and perspectives unite to create innovative solutions. 
 







 When you join us, you become part of something bigger: a collaborative culture that crosses borders and disciplines, bringing out the best in every team member to deliver breakthrough results for our clients and partners.  
 







 Together, we are transforming the payments industry \- challenging, supporting, and inspiring one another in the process.
 







 Please note, we retain applicant data for 12 months for recruitment purposes and future opportunities, after which it is securely deleted. At CellPoint Digital we are committed to be globally compliant with robust data protection.

**Overview**
 The position of human resources manager consists of planning, directing, and coordinating human resource management activities of an organization to maximize the strategic use of human resources and maintain functions such as employee compensation, recruitment, personnel policies, and regulatory compliance.
   

  

**Tasks/ KRAs**
* Administer compensation, benefits and performance management systems, and safety and recreation programs
* Advise managers on organizational policy matters such as equal employment opportunity and sexual harassment, and recommend needed changes
* Analyze and modify compensation and benefit policies to establish competitive programs and ensure compliance with legal requirements
* Identify staff vacancies and recruit, interview and select applicants
* Perform difficult staffing duties, including dealing with understaffing, refereeing disputes, firing employees, and administering disciplinary procedures
* Plan and conduct new employee orientation to foster positive attitude toward organizational objectives
* Plan, direct, supervise, and coordinate work activities of subordinates and staff relating to employment, compensation, labor relations, and employee relations
* Plan, organize, direct, control or coordinate the personnel, training, or labor relations activities of an organization
* Represent the organization at personnel\-related hearings and investigations
* Serve as a link between management and employees by handling questions, interpreting and administering contracts and helping resolve work\-related problems.

* Bachelor's degree in human resources or a related field
* Master’s degree in human resources or a related field
* Ability to give full attention to what other people are saying, to motivate, develop, and direct people as they work, and identify the best people for the job
* Ability to be aware of others' reactions and understanding why they react as they do, to use logic and reason to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, and to bring others together and trying to reconcile differences
* 4 – 6 years of relevant experience in the HR domain

description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance:**
 At CoinDCX, our mission is clear \- to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance. As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2\.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale. We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what’s next. If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.
   

  

**About the Role:**
 At CoinDCX, the HR Business Partner serves as a critical link between business strategy and people initiatives. Operating within a dedicated HRBP team structure, this Manager\-level role reports directly to the AVP \- HRBP and will collaborate closely with Senior Manager counterparts to manage a diverse portfolio.
   

  

 You will be the people and culture architect for the Bangalore office, responsible for driving a high\-performance culture, ensuring talent strategy alignment, and managing the full employee lifecycle for all Non\-Tech Business Units. Your mandate extends to acting as the dedicated HRBP for select Technology teams: Infosec, Analytics, and Enterprise IT. This role calls for a strategic partner who can operate at the intersection of local Bangalore dynamics, compliance requirements, and CoinDCX's high\-growth culture to ensure our talent strategy endures market cycles and drives operational excellence. You will partner closely with Function Heads, managers and the central HR team to execute people\-centric programs across your diverse portfolio.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Strategic Advisory: Strategically partner with Leads and Managers in the Bangalore office to define and drive the people agenda, serving as a trusted advisor to cultivate the desired high\-performance culture and translate function\-specific insights into organization\-wide programs and interventions.
* Data Insights: Design, analyze, and interpret key people metrics and business unit data (e.g., attrition, engagement, performance) to identify systemic trends, predict future challenges, and recommend proactive, data\-driven solutions that enhance operational excellence, performance, and retention.
* Lifecycle Management: Own the comprehensive employee lifecycle across all non\-tech and select tech teams (Infosec, Analytics, and Enterprise IT), continuously optimizing processes from onboarding through performance management, career pathing, and offboarding to ensure efficiency and a seamless employee experience.
* Agile Innovation: Embrace a culture of change and agility, operating with an AI\-first mindset to identify opportunities for automation and efficiency across HR processes and people initiatives.
* Performance Coaching: Establish and champion a culture of continuous, transparent performance feedback and communication. Proactively coach managers on effective performance management, difficult conversations, and conflict resolution, maintaining a strong pulse of the floor through listening channels and translating feedback into collaborative action plans.
* Site Communication: Lead the site\-level communication charter and execute targeted cross\-functional interventions to ensure clarity, alignment, and drive organizational change.
* Functional Alignment: Drive monthly functional all\-hands ensuring smooth communication flow within all units.
* Culture Building: Spearhead the development and implementation of robust retention frameworks and cultural initiatives within the Bangalore office, including leading independent, thorough investigations for employee grievances and cultivating a strong sense of organizational belongingness and compliance.
* Strategic Partnership: Actively undertake additional responsibilities and strategically partner with other HR sub\-units, such as Talent Acquisition and Employer Branding, to support key initiatives such as organizing on\-the\-floor events.


**You’ll Excel in This Role If You**
* Strategic Influencer: You possess a demonstrable ability to advise, influence, and partner with senior business leads to proactively define the people agenda and achieve critical organizational results.
* Champion of High\-Performance Culture: You are passionate about building and scaling an employee\-first, high\-trust, and high\-performance culture across diverse teams.
* Data\-Driven and Analytical: You move beyond anecdotal solutions, using people data (e.g., attrition, engagement, and performance metrics) to identify systemic issues and build predictive, scalable HR systems.
* You have substantial experience as an HR Business Partner, preferably within mid\-sized/ large tech/ fintech startups or high\-growth technology environments, with strong familiarity in partnering with varied functions.


**You’ll Know You’re Winning When**
* Culture: Measurable uplift in eNPS and Organizational Health scores for supported teams, reflecting a high\-trust, high\-performance culture.
* Performance: Consistent achievement of performance goals across supported teams, demonstrated by performance distribution metrics and effective utilization of performance management tools.
* Retention \& Talent: Proactive reduction in undesirable attrition across supported teams and successful implementation of career pathing frameworks.
* Impact: Recognized by business leaders as a strategic partner who proactively solves systemic people challenges with data\-driven interventions and first principles thinking.


**Why This Role Matters \& What’s In It For You**
 As a Manager/Senior Manager HRBP, you are not just an executor but a strategic architect shaping the talent landscape of India’s first crypto unicorn. This high\-stakes role offers you the unique opportunity to partner directly with senior leadership to institutionalize a high\-performance culture and architect people strategies in a hyper\-growth industry. By bridging business goals with innovative human capital solutions, you will gain unparalleled expertise in navigating complex organizational transformations and building an enduring, resilient culture that thrives across market cycles.
   

  

**Hiring Process**
 Here’s what your journey with us looks like:
   

  

* Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent
* Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better
* Strategic \& Functional Deep\-dive – Deep dive into your approach \& craft, including a live problem\-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios
* Culture \& Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best
* Stakeholder Conversation – You may meet our function leader(s) to explore strategic alignment and long\-term fit


**Where We Work**
 We believe that high\-impact collaboration and organizational agility are best cultivated through shared physical presence. At CoinDCX, our commitment to building together in person drives the speed, trust, and innovation necessary to lead the industry. As such, we operate as a work\-from\-office organization. This role is strategically based at our Bangalore location, where you will be at the heart of our culture, driving alignment and real\-time impact.
   

  

**Perks That Empower You**
 We believe great people deserve great experiences.
   

  

* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need
* Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources
* Learning Sessions: Bi\-weekly learning and growth opportunities


**Ready to Architect the Future of Work?**
 If you're ready to step into a strategic role where you'll architect culture, drive organizational transformation, and have a deep impact on a hyper\-growth unicorn, this is your opportunity. Join CoinDCX and help us define the next chapter of finance in India, together.

As a market leader in enterprise analytics and mobility software, we've pioneered the BI and analytics space, empowering people to make better decisions and revolutionizing how businesses operate.
   

  

 But that's not all. Strategy is also leading a groundbreaking shift in how companies approach their treasury reserve strategy, boldly adopting Bitcoin as a key asset. This visionary move is reshaping the financial landscape and solidifying our position as a forward\-thinking, innovative force in the market. Four years after adopting the Bitcoin Standard, Strategy's stock has outperformed every company in the S\&P 500\.
   

  

 Our people are the core of our success. At Strategy, you'll join a team of smart, creative minds working on dynamic projects with cutting\-edge technologies. We thrive on curiosity, innovation, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.
   

  

 Our corporate values—bold, agile, engaged, impactful, and united—are the foundation of our culture. As we lead the charge into the new era of AI and financial innovation, we foster an environment where every employee's contributions are recognized and valued.
   

  

**The Role**
 Establish daily priorities and activities relating to all cloud and network infrastructure, including designing, implementing, and managing global hybrid and multi\-cloud network architectures across AWS, Azure, and GCP. This role operates in a hands\-on, high\-tech, operational capacity and works closely with Information Systems leadership to define and execute strategic goals for cloud networking, security, connectivity, and automation.
   

  

**Your Focus**
 Cloud \& Network Architecture
   

  

* Manage full life\-cycle processes (define, design, develop, deploy) for projects related to the modernization, upgrade, and ongoing maintenance of hybrid and multi\-cloud network infrastructure.
* Design, implement, and support cloud network architectures across AWS VPC, Azure vNet, and GCP VPC including routing, segmentation, security policies, and traffic flows.
* Engineer high\-availability cloud connectivity solutions using AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, GCP Cloud Interconnect, Site\-to\-Site VPN, IPSec, BGP, and other hybrid routing mechanisms.
* Support cloud operations across AWS, Azure, and GCP for all network\-related activities, ensuring secure and optimized cloud performance.


 Cloud Security, Routing \& Traffic Engineering
   

  

* Implement and maintain cloud\-native security controls: AWS Security Groups \& NACLs, Azure NSGs/ASGs, GCP firewall rules, and cloud routing policies.
* Deploy and maintain cloud load balancing solutions (ALB/NLB, Azure Load Balancer, Azure App Gateway, GCP GLB).
* Integrate cloud networking with Zero Trust security principles and identity\-based segmentation.


 Automation \& Monitoring
   

  

* Deploy cloud\-native monitoring and logging solutions (CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, GCP Cloud Operations Suite) and integrate with enterprise NMS tools.
* Build and maintain automated network provisioning pipelines using Terraform, CloudFormation, Azure Bicep, and CI/CD tooling.
* Promote automation and operational efficiency across security, systems engineering, and cloud operations teams.


 Operational Support \& Leadership
   

  

* Serve as a key escalation point for complex cloud and network issues across AWS, Azure, GCP, and on\-prem environments.
* Prepare management reporting on network health, cloud uptime, connectivity incidents, and performance trends.
* Develop and maintain operational best practices for cloud networking, security, and monitoring.
* Lead cross\-functional project teams to deliver scalable cloud network initiatives.


 Strategic Research \& Governance
   

  

* Evaluate emerging cloud networking technologies and propose strategic improvements.
* Identify and implement cost\-effective cloud connectivity, routing, and security solutions.
* Document cloud architecture standards, network design changes, and operational procedures.


**Qualifications**
 Core Attributes:
   

  

 Motivation. Passion. Integrity. Innovation. Collaboration. Customer Focus.
   

  

**Experience \& Skills**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 2\+ years experience in a corporate IT environment.
* 2–4 years hands\-on experience designing and supporting cloud and hybrid network architectures.
* Hands\-on experience with:
+ AWS: VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, PrivateLink, Route 53, NAT Gateway
+ Azure: vNet, ExpressRoute, Virtual WAN, NSG/ASG, Private Link, Azure Firewall
+ GCP: VPC, Shared VPC, Cloud Interconnect, HA VPN, Cloud Router, Cloud Armor

* Experience designing and supporting multi\-cloud connectivity and advanced routing (BGP, IPSec tunnels, hub/spoke, global routing).
* Experience with Terraform for network automation.
* Experience with Palo Alto, Fortinet or similar cloud firewalls.
* Strong understanding of routing protocols (OSPF, BGP), VLANs, routing design, and segmentation.
* Working knowledge of SNMP, TACACS\+, RADIUS, IPSec, IPv6 and network security frameworks.
* Expertise in Python for automation, orchestration, and tooling.
* Proficiency in regular expressions (regex).
* Excellent troubleshooting skills across cloud networking, virtual firewalls, and hybrid environments.
* Ability to lead large\-scale network/cloud projects.
* Exceptional communication, customer support, and prioritization skills.
* Preferred Certifications: AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty, Microsoft AZ\-700, Google Professional Cloud Network Engineer, or Cisco CCNP


 Additional Information: As part of the hiring process, candidates will be required to complete an online assessment. The selected candidate will be expected to work full\-time from the Strategy Pune office.

 development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts.
